items.question: How many free appraisals do I get?
items.answer: If you're not signed up, you get 3 appraisals per day. Sign up for free and you get 12 per day. Premium Startup ($79/mo) gets 30 per day, and Premium Enterprise ($129/mo) gets unlimited.

items.question: What's the difference between name search and appraisal?
items.answer: Name search is free and instant — it tells you if a domain is available, shows WHOIS if taken, or ranks it Premium/Mid/Low if available. Appraisal is the deep 16-dimension analysis that scores pronounceability, trademark risk, brandability, and estimated value.

items.question: How does Try Your Luck work?
items.answer: Pick a TLD (.com, .net, .io, or .co) and pay the TLD-specific price. Three closed boxes appear with a spinning animation. Pick one when it stops. You get a unique premium domain revealed instantly. It's locked — no one else can buy it. Or pay a flat $19 without selecting a TLD.

items.question: What happens after I reveal a domain name?
items.answer: After reveal, the domain is yours to evaluate. We show you direct links to register it at Dynadot, Namecheap, or Porkbun. You choose where to register — we don't lock you into a registrar.

items.question: What's included in the Premium subscription?
items.answer: Premium Startup ($79/mo) gives you 30 appraisals/day plus access to the Domain Scanner (DA, spam score, backlinks), Extended Insights (USPTO/WIPO, trademark history), and Bulk Domain Audit. Enterprise ($129/mo) adds unlimited appraisals, API access, and priority support.

items.question: Can I sell my domains on Ceche?
items.answer: Yes. List your premium domain on our marketplace. We appraise it, you set the price. Standard listing is $5, priority placement is $10. We take 8-15% commission on successful sales depending on the sale price.

items.question: Is my search data private?
items.answer: Yes. Domain names you search are encrypted with AES-256-GCM before storage. We don't sell or share search data. Your competition won't see what you're looking at.

helpFaq.desc: Answers to the most common questions about Ceche — pricing, tools, API, marketplace, and account management.

items.a: Ceche is a domain marketplace where premium names are bought and sold. The appraisal engine proves value with 16-dimension scoring. The search and scanner tools help you find names. Everything connects to the marketplace.

items.q: How does the appraisal engine work?
items.a: The appraisal engine uses Ceche's proprietary 16-Dimension Framework to evaluate domains across four categories: Lexical Analysis (30%), Technical Authority (25%), Market Dynamics (25%), and Brandability (20%). Each dimension is scored independently and combined using statistically derived weights.

Ceche supports .com, .net, .io, and .co domains. The Domain Database tracks pricing and registration data for 2,847 TLDs, but appraisal and marketplace features are currently limited to these four extensions.

items.q: How do I create an account?
items.a: Click 'Signup Free' in the navigation. Free accounts include 12 appraisals per day, basic SEO Scanner access, and full Help Center access. No credit card required.

Free: 12 appraisals/day, basic SEO Scanner, Help Center. Startup ($79/mo): 30 appraisals/day, full SEO Scanner, Extended Insights ($5-$50/report), Bulk Analyzer, Trademark Monitor, Domain Database, priority support. Enterprise ($129/mo): unlimited appraisals, all Startup features, API access (10,000 calls/day), dedicated account manager, private Slack channel, custom reporting.

items.q: How does Try Your Luck pricing work?
items.a: Try Your Luck offers mystery domain acquisitions at flat rates: .com ($79), .net ($39), .io ($29), .co ($9), or any TLD ($19 flat). Each acquisition includes a Ceche valuation report with 16-dimension scoring.

Standard listing: $5 per domain. Priority listing: $10 per domain (includes 72-hour visibility boost). Commission: 8-15% of final sale price on a sliding scale — 15% for transactions under $500, 12% for $500-$5,000, 10% for $5,000-$50,000, 8% for above $50,000.
No. All fees for digital goods (reveals, subscriptions, marketplace, Try Your Luck) are non-refundable.

items.q: What's the difference between SEO Scanner and Extended Insights?
items.a: The SEO Scanner evaluates search visibility, backlink profile, organic traffic history, and keyword relevance — returning results in 3-5 seconds. Extended Insights provides deeper due diligence including trademark screening, comparable sales, and buyer intent scoring.

items.q: How does the Bulk Analyzer work?
items.a: Upload a CSV with one column (header: 'domain') and one domain per row. Output includes Domain Name, Ceche Valuation, 16-Dimension Score, Priority Score (1-100), Recommended Action, and Estimated Sale Time. Processing time for 5,000 domains is approximately 2 minutes 28 seconds.

items.q: How does the Trademark Monitor work?
items.a: Add domains to your monitor list from the dashboard. The tool screens new USPTO and WIPO filings daily. You receive email alerts within 24 hours. Severity levels: Critical (identical mark in related class), High (similar mark in different class), Medium (similar mark, different goods), Low (partial match).

items.q: How do I authenticate API requests?
items.a: Include your API key in the Authorization header as a Bearer token: Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY. Generate keys from Account Settings > API Keys.

items.q: What are the API rate limits?
items.a: Free: 100 calls/day. Startup ($79/mo): 500 calls/day. Enterprise ($129/mo): 10,000 calls/day. Rate limit resets daily at 00:00 UTC.
Official SDKs are available for Python, JavaScript/Node.js, Go, and Ruby. Webhook configuration is available for automated notifications with retry logic using exponential backoff.
Premium subscribers receive responses within 4 business hours. Free account users within 24 business hours. Enterprise subscribers can also reach the support team through the private Slack channel.
Yes. Cancel anytime from Account Settings > Billing. You retain Premium access until the end of your current billing cycle. Subscription fees are non-refundable.
